impacts.description: Contribution to achieving open strategic autonomy in digital and emerging enabling technologies through next-generation AI agent research and innovation, addressing the destination of the HORIZON-CL4-2026-05 call.

Real-world application of next-generation AI agents across Apply AI sectors, with portfolio coverage ensuring at least one funded project each in healthcare, advanced manufacturing, and in-vehicle autonomous driving, advancing productivity and safety in those industrial domains.
Direct contribution to the Apply AI Strategy through generation and validation of next-generation AI agent results applicable across economic sectors.
Strengthening the European R&D community in AI by sharing communicable results through the AI-on-demand platform, building shared knowledge infrastructure for the European AI ecosystem.

Deployment and uptake of AI agent results through European Digital Innovation Hubs (EDIHs), with validation in Testing and Experiment Facilities and access to AI Factories and Data Labs, accelerating diffusion into the European digital economy.
Reinforcement of the European Partnership on AI, Data and Robotics (ADRA) ecosystem through mandatory cohesion activities, contributing to coordinated European AI research and innovation capacity.
impacts.inference_note: The source directly mandates allocation of tasks for cohesion activities with ADRA (mandatory_cohesion_activities field and scope text: 'all proposals are expected to allocate tasks for cohesion activities with ADRA'). The broader impact on the ADRA ecosystem and European AI research capacity is derived by logical inference: mandatory cohesion task allocation across all selected projects in this topic necessarily contributes to ADRA's partnership-level scientific and innovation goals.
